svg.text: D3. NRH Registry, universal addressing schema
One address space for every artifact in the operation. Hash-chained transitions make the registry tamper-evident.
NRH-RG-SCHEMA-001 (corrected Nov 2026) | NEURUH CODEX v1.1.0 | 2026-11-10 | Every number carries an audit date.
ADDRESS ANATOMY
NRH - DD - ENT - TTT - NNN EXAMPLE: NRH-RE-LOS-REP-001
PREFIX (fixed namespace root) | DOMAIN (10 Jul / 9 Nov) | ENTITY (48 seeded Jul / 35 Nov) | TYPE (36 artifact types) | SEQUENCE (zero-padded ordinal)
Resolvable, sortable, collision-free, human-legible.
STORAGE AND RUNTIME
Engine: SQLite, WAL journal mode.
Interface: nrh.py, stdlib Python only, zero pip dependencies.
Rationale: no dependency surface, no supply-chain rot on the truth layer.
Portability: single file. Survives machine loss, hosting loss, org change.
TRANSITION LOG, HASH CHAIN
TX 0 -> TX 1 -> TX 2 -> TX 3, each h(prev || state).
SPEC RULE R2: strip NRH ID tokens before hashing.
DEFECT RESOLVED: self-referential hash convergence,
ID inside the hashed payload.
SIX OPEN DECISIONS, REGISTRY BLOCKED PENDING FOUNDER RULING
01 FM domain: create or fold into an existing domain.
02 Tier semantics: what tier means at registry level vs audit level.
03 origin_thread: promote to first-class THR entity type.
04 EVIDENCES: structural requirement or optional edge.
05 BirdDog / DeedSonar: entity boundary between lead-source and CRM.
06 DF domain seeding: defense namespace under export-control gate.
NOVEMBER CORRECTION: no repo named neuruh-registry or neurh-registry exists in the org (both 404, verified 2026-11-10).
The registry lives only as content (vault, transcripts, demos). Live visual: neuruh-demos/nrh-registry/.
Figure D3. NRH addressing schema. The July D3 is structurally sound; the domain/entity counts are now in conflict (see Appendix F).
